name: Disk, Partition & Filesystem Tools
shortDesc: Partition resizing, SMART drive health diagnostic, and multi-ISO bootable flash utilities.
detailedDesc: Manage physical NVMe/SSD drives, USB drives, and format filesystems.

phase.title: System Administration, Disks & Security
phase.description: Disk partition utilities, ISO flashers, firewall interfaces, and input method editors (IME).

packages.name: GNOME Disks (Recommended GUI)
packages.description: Clean, reliable disk management utility for formatting drives, inspecting SMART health, creating disk images, and benchmarking.

packages.name: ncdu (Recommended TUI Disk Usage)
packages.description: Fast NCurses disk usage analyzer for finding large files and folders in your terminal.
pros: Instant deletion of unwanted temp files

packages.name: GParted
packages.description: Dedicated graphical partition editor for creating, deleting, and resizing partitions (ext4, btrfs, NTFS, FAT).

packages.name: Ventoy (Multi-ISO USB Creator)
packages.description: Tool to create bootable USB drives where you simply copy ISO files directly to the stick without reformatting.
pros: Boot dozens of different Linux ISOs from one USB flash drive
No formatting needed to add new ISOs
